title: 第十章 密议第十一章 金刀
content_zh:
“不错，”玄机老人的声音在静谧的屋内显得格外沉重，带着一种穿透岁月的笃定，“当时这四位高手，无不是各自领域里登峰造极的人物。那一战，便是在首阳山之巅展开的。那一日狂风呼啸，云海翻腾，可说是空前绝后的一战。起初，除了秦笑歌深知东方叶帝的恐怖外，另外三人皆觉得此人太过狂妄，居然扬言要一人独斗当世四大顶尖高手。然而，真正一交手，他们才惊觉，东方叶帝的剑法早已超越了凡俗武学的范畴，达到了某种近乎‘道’的境界。”
老人顿了顿，目光中流露出深深的敬畏：“前十招，上官长乐引以为傲的‘逍遥棍法’仅仅攻出了五棍，便被对方轻描淡写地化解于无形；秦笑歌的大衍剑法刺出了五剑，却如泥牛入海，激不起半点波澜；号称‘武林第一刀’的燕留刀，拼尽全力也只攻出了三刀；而那心狠手辣的黑道巨擘长眉冷魔，更是狠命劈出了五掌，均被那东方叶帝一一从容挡下。到了后来的十招，局势彻底逆转，四人只能勉强招架，竟连还手攻出一招的机会都没有！最惨烈的是那长眉冷魔，仅仅一个照面，便被一剑精准无比地刺中了肩井穴，半生苦修的阴毒功力瞬间废去大半。”
“二十招过后，那东方叶帝便缓缓收剑而立，神色间竟无半分胜利的喜悦，反而充满了无尽的落寞。他看着面前气喘吁吁、面色苍白的四人，叹息道：‘我原本希望你四人能赐我一败，一解我心中积压多年的孤寂。想不到这种快乐只延续了短短十招，难道茫茫天下，找一个真正的对手竟是如此之难！’说完，他便将手中长剑随手弃于山崖之下，头也不回地飘然而去。”
玄机老人讲完这段往事，屋内陷入了死一般的寂静。上官复只觉得后背阵阵发凉，心惊肉跳，仿佛亲身经历了那场惊心动魄的大战，亲眼目睹了那位绝世剑客的风采。过了许久，他才缓过神来，干涩地问道：“既然此战如此惊天动地，为何此前武林中从未听说过这样一场比试？”
玄机老人苦笑一声，答道：“你想想，那四位前辈高人都是武林中盛名一时的人物，自尊心极强。这场比试对他们而言，简直是毕生的奇耻大辱，谁愿意将这样的丑闻公之于众？所以这场比武被严格保密，知情者寥寥无几。此战之后，秦笑歌便极少在江湖露面，据说这位前辈在见识了真正的巅峰后，便隐居深山，穷尽余生去钻研更高一层的剑理；而长眉冷魔则远赴塞外苦寒之地，再未踏足中原半步。”
“那这些陈年旧事，和如今江湖中出现的‘绝代一剑’又有何关系呢？”上官复追问道，眼中满是急切与困惑。
玄机老人长长地叹了一口气，目光变得迷离而深邃：“那东方叶帝晚年参透生死，临死之际，并没有留下什么繁复的剑谱秘籍，而是将自己毕生的武道感悟，浓缩成了一道剑意，世人称之为‘绝代一剑’。他曾留下一句震烁古今的遗言：‘成功只是一剑，失败也是一剑；相见只有一剑，别离也是一剑；滔滔人生，只有一剑。’这一剑，不再是单纯的杀人之术，而是包含了世间万物的生灭枯荣，是极致的美学，也是极致的毁灭。可惜啊，一代剑圣纵横无敌的武林绝学，留下的竟然就只有这孤零零的一招剑式。”
说到这里，玄机老人的声音微微颤抖起来，带着一种难以言喻的震撼：“方才听你描述，那青年一剑斩杀长春真人与韩猛，快得让人看不清招式，只有璀璨如星辰般的剑光一闪即逝。这种意境，这种霸道绝伦又凄美至极的剑意，除了传说中东方叶帝的‘绝代一剑’，老夫实在想不出世间还有第二种武功能够做到！”
上官复倒吸一口凉气，手中的茶杯险些拿捏不住：“您是说……那个不知名的青年，竟然学会了两百年前那位剑圣的绝学？这怎么可能？那可是已经失传了两个世纪的传说啊！”
“这也是老夫感到恐惧的地方。”玄机老人压低了声音，仿佛怕惊扰了什么不可名状的存在，“如果那真的是‘绝代一剑’，那么此人的出现，必将掀起一场席卷整个武林的血雨腥风。当年东方叶帝凭此剑横扫天下，如今若有人重现此剑，只怕当年的噩梦又要重演。上官帮主，你这次惹上的，恐怕不仅仅是一个青年高手，而是一个足以颠覆江湖秩序的庞然大物。”
窗外雨声渐急，打在窗棂上噼啪作响，屋内的气氛压抑到了极点。上官复望着摇曳不定的烛火，心中原本的雄心壮志此刻竟生出了一丝难以抑制的寒意。他意识到，自己正站在一个巨大的风暴中心，而这个风暴的名字，就叫“绝代一剑”。

content_en:
"Yes," Old Man Xuanji's voice sounded particularly heavy in the quiet room, with a kind of determination that penetrated through the years, "At that time, these four masters were all the pinnacle figures in their respective fields. That battle took place on the top of Shouyang Mountain. That day, the wind howled and the sea of clouds rolled, it could be said to be an unprecedented battle. . At first, except for Qin Xiaoge, who was well aware of the terror of Dongfang Ye Emperor, the other three people thought that this person was too arrogant and actually threatened to fight against the four top masters in the world. However, when they actually fought, they were shocked that Dongfang Ye Emperor's swordsmanship had already surpassed the realm of ordinary martial arts and reached something close to the 'Tao'."
The old man paused, with deep awe in his eyes: "In the first ten moves, Shangguan Changle's proud 'Xiaoyao Stick Technique' only struck five sticks, and was easily neutralized by the opponent; Qin Xiaoge's Dayan Sword Technique struck out five swords, but it was like a mud cow entering the sea, without causing any waves; the Yanliu Dao, known as the 'No. 1 Sword in the Wulin', tried its best to only hit three swords; and the ruthless swordsman The underworld giant Long Eyebrow Leng Mo struck out five times, but Dongfang Ye Di calmly blocked them one by one. In the next ten moves, the situation was completely reversed. The four of them could only barely parry, and they didn't even have a chance to fight back! The most tragic thing was that Long Eyebrow Leng Mo was stabbed with precision in Jianjing point after just one encounter, and most of the sinister skills he had cultivated for a lifetime were instantly wiped out.
"After twenty moves, Dongfang Yedi slowly sheathed his sword and stood up. There was no joy of victory in his expression, but instead was full of endless loneliness. He looked at the four panting and pale people in front of him and sighed: 'I originally hoped that you four could give me a defeat. The loneliness that had been building up in my heart for many years was relieved. I never thought that this happiness lasted only ten moves. How could it be so difficult to find a real opponent in this vast world? ' After saying that, he threw the sword in his hand under the cliff and floated away without looking back. "
After Old Man Xuanji told this story, the room fell into a deathly silence. Shangguan Fu felt a chill on his back and his heart was beating with fear, as if he had personally experienced that thrilling battle and witnessed the elegance of that peerless swordsman. After a long time, he regained his composure and asked dryly: "Since this battle is so earth-shattering, why has such a competition never been heard of in the martial arts world before?"
The old man Xuanji smiled bitterly and replied: "Think about it, those four senior masters are all famous figures in the martial arts world and have extremely strong self-esteem. For them, this competition is simply a lifelong shame and humiliation. Who is willing to make such a scandal public? Therefore, this competition is kept strictly confidential. , there are very few people who know about it. After this battle, Qin Xiaoge rarely appeared in the world. It is said that after seeing the true peak, this senior lived in seclusion in the mountains and spent the rest of his life studying the higher level of swordsmanship; while the long-browed cold demon went to the bitter cold outside the Great Wall and never set foot in the Central Plains."
"Then what do these old events have to do with the 'unparalleled sword' that appears in the world today?" Shangguan Fu asked, his eyes full of eagerness and confusion.
The old man Xuanji let out a long sigh, and his eyes became blurred and profound: "The Dongfang Ye Emperor understood life and death in his later years. When he was about to die, he did not leave any complicated sword manual secrets. Instead, he condensed his lifelong martial arts insights into a sword intention, which the world called the 'unparalleled sword'. He once left a last words that shocked the ancient and modern times: 'Success is just a sword, failure is just a sword. There is only one sword for defeat; there is only one sword for separation; and there is only one sword for separation. 'This sword is no longer a simple killing technique, but contains the life and death of all things in the world. It is the ultimate aesthetics and the ultimate destruction. It is a pity that the invincible martial arts skills of a generation of sword masters only have this single sword move."
Speaking of which,Old Man Xuanji's voice trembled slightly, with an indescribable shock: "I just heard you describe how the young man killed Changchun Master and Han Meng with one sword. It was so fast that people couldn't see the moves, and only the sword light was as bright as stars. It flashed away. This kind of artistic conception, this kind of domineering and extremely poignant sword intention, except for the legendary Dongfang Ye Emperor's 'Peerless Sword', I really can't think of another kind of martial arts in the world that can achieve this!"
Shangguan Fu took a breath and could hardly hold the tea cup in his hand: "You mean... that unknown young man actually learned the secret skill of the sword master two hundred years ago? How is this possible? That is a legend that has been lost for two centuries!"
"This is also where I feel scared." Old Man Xuanji lowered his voice, as if he was afraid of disturbing some unspeakable existence, "If that is really the 'Peerless Sword', then the appearance of this person will surely set off a bloody storm that will sweep through the entire martial arts world. . Back then Dongfang Ye Emperor conquered the world with this sword. If someone reappears with this sword, I am afraid that the nightmare of that year will happen again. Shangguan Gang Leader, I am afraid that what you have encountered is not just a young master, but a behemoth that can subvert the order of the world. "
The sound of rain outside the window was getting heavier and louder, hitting the window lattice with crackling sounds, and the atmosphere in the house was extremely depressing. Shangguan looked at the flickering candlelight again, and the original ambition in his heart actually gave birth to an uncontrollable chill at this moment. He realized that he was standing in the center of a huge storm, and the name of this storm was "Peerless Sword".
